raw_segments.text: But I should like Alyosha, too. Ah, Aleksey Fyodorovich, forgive my calling you simply
Alyosha. I should like Aleksey Fyodorovich, too, to tell me before my two friends whether
I am right. I feel instinctively that you, Alyosha, my
dear brother, for you are a dear brother to me," she said again ecstatically, taking
his cold hand in her hot one. I foresee that your decision, your approval,
will bring me peace in spite of all my sufferings, for after your words I shall be calm and submit.
